title: Multi-asset carry seam — FX byte-identity
description: The asset-class-agnostic carry seam (celnet-core::carry on celnet-types::Carry) must lower the FX two-rate arm to VanillaInputs byte-identically, and must reject the generalized CostOfCarry arm on the FX lowering path. This is the frozen-contract acceptance for the deliverable 'carry-seam'.

assertions.statement: fx_vanilla_inputs lowers Carry::FxRates{r_dom,r_for} to VanillaInputs with forward, df_dom and df_for byte-identical (to_bits equality) to the direct VanillaInputs::new(spot,strike,vol,t,r_dom,r_for) construction.
The FX lowering path rejects (returns Err) when handed the generalized Carry::CostOfCarry arm — no silent fallback to a defaulted two-rate form.
Carry::discount_rate() is the single asset-class-agnostic source of the numeraire/discount rate r used in e^{-r·t}: r_dom for FxRates, r for CostOfCarry; a pure field read with no side effects.
